raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'calendar_entries_couple_id_immutable';\r\n  end if;\r\n  if new.created_by <> old.created_by and not repair_transfer then\r\n    raise exception public.bond_weekly_quests%rowtype;\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  cid uuid;\n  next_confirmed uuid[];\n  valid_confirmers integer;\n  new_xp integer;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then\n    raise exception 'Not authenticated';\n  end if;\n\n  cid := private.current_couple_id();\n  if cid is null then\n    raise exception 'Couple not found';\n  end if;\n\n  select *\n    into q\n  from public.bond_weekly_quests\n  where id = target_quest_id\n    and couple_id = cid\n  for update;\n\n  if not found then\n    raise exception 'Quest not found';\n  end if;\n\n  if q.week_start <> private.bond_week_start_rome(now()) then\n    raise exception 'Quest week is closed';\n  end if;\n\n  if q.completed_at is not null then\n    select bond_xp\n      into new_xp\n    from public.couples\n    where id = q.couple_id;\n\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'completed', true,\n      'bond_xp', new_xp,\n      'confirmed_by', q.confirmed_by\n    );\n  end if;\n\n  next_confirmed := coalesce(q.confirmed_by, '{}'::uuid[]);\n\n  if array_position(next_confirmed, uid) is null then\n    next_confirmed := array_append(next_confirmed, uid);\n  end if;\n\n  select count(distinct p.id)::integer\n    into valid_confirmers\n  from public.profiles p\n  where p.couple_id = q.couple_id\n    and p.id = any(next_confirmed);\n\n  if valid_confirmers >= 2 then\n    update public.bond_weekly_quests\n      set confirmed_by = next_confirmed,\n          completed_at = now()\n    where id = q.id;\n\n    update public.couples\n      set bond_xp = bond_xp + q.xp\n    where id = q.couple_id\n    returning bond_xp into new_xp;\n\n    insert into public.activity(couple_id, actor_id, type, payload)\n    values (\n      q.couple_id,\n      uid,\n      'bond_quest_completed',\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'quest_id', q.id,\n        'title', q.title,\n        'xp', q.xp\n      )\n    );\n\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'completed', true,\n      'bond_xp', new_xp,\n      'confirmed_by', next_confirmed,\n      'xp_awarded', q.xp\n    );\n  end if;\n\n  update public.bond_weekly_quests\n    set confirmed_by = next_confirmed\n  where id = q.id;\n\n  select bond_xp\n    into new_xp\n  from public.couples\n  where id = q.couple_id;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'completed', false,\n    'bond_xp', new_xp,\n    'confirmed_by', next_confirmed\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.current_couple_id()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_couple_id()\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE actor_role\n    from public.profiles as profile\n   where profile.id = auth.uid()\n     and profile.couple_id is not null;\n\n  if current_couple is null or actor_role not in ('francesco', 'beatrice') private.ensure_bond_week_internal()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  cid uuid;\n  week date;\n  quest_mode text;\n  slot_no integer;\n  pool text[];\n  candidates text[];\n  used_keys text[];\n  picked_key text;\n  picked public.bond_quest_templates%rowtype;\n  pick_index integer;\n  quest_count integer;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then\n    raise exception 'Not authenticated';\n  end if;\n\n  cid := private.current_couple_id();\n  if cid is null then\n    raise exception 'Couple not found';\n  end if;\n\n  week := private.bond_week_start_rome(now());\n\n  insert into public.bond_weekly_state(couple_id, week_start, rerolls_used)\n  values (cid, week, 0)\n  on conflict (couple_id, week_start) do nothing;\n\n  perform 1\n  from public.bond_weekly_state\n  where couple_id = cid and week_start = week\n  for update;\n\n  quest_mode := private.bond_mode_for_couple(cid);\n\n  for slot_no in 1..3 loop\n    if exists (\n      select 1\n      from public.bond_weekly_quests\n      where couple_id = cid\n        and week_start = week\n        and slot = slot_no\n    ) then\n      continue;\n    end if;\n\n    select coalesce(array_agg(template_key order by template_key), '{}'::text[])\n      into used_keys\n    from public.bond_weekly_quests\n    where couple_id = cid\n      and week_start = week;\n\n    select array_agg(t.key order by t.key)\n      into pool\n    from public.bond_quest_templates t\n    where t.active = true\n      and (t.mode = 'any' or t.mode = quest_mode)\n      and (\n        (slot_no = 1 and t.rarity in ('common', 'uncommon'))\n        or (slot_no = 2 and t.rarity in ('uncommon', 'rare'))\n        or (slot_no = 3 and t.rarity in ('rare', 'epic'))\n      );\n\n    if coalesce(cardinality(pool), 0) = 0 then\n      select array_agg(t.key order by t.key)\n        into pool\n      from public.bond_quest_templates t\n      where t.active = true\n        and (t.mode = 'any' or t.mode = quest_mode);\n    end if;\n\n    select array_agg(k order by k)\n      into candidates\n    from unnest(coalesce(pool, '{}'::text[])) as k\n    where not (k = any(coalesce(used_keys, '{}'::text[])));\n\n    if coalesce(cardinality(candidates), 0) = 0 then\n      continue;\n    end if;\n\n    pick_index :=\n      (private.bond_hash_seed(\n        cid::text || '|' || week::text || '|' || slot_no::text || '|bond'\n      ) % cardinality(candidates))::integer + 1;\n\n    picked_key := candidates[pick_index];\n\n    select *\n      into picked\n    from public.bond_quest_templates\n    where key = picked_key\n      and active = true;\n\n    if not found then\n      raise exception 'Quest template disappeared during initialization';\n    end if;\n\n    insert into public.bond_weekly_quests(\n      couple_id,\n      week_start,\n      slot,\n      template_key,\n      title,\n      category,\n      rarity,\n      xp,\n      confirmed_by,\n      completed_at\n    )\n    values (\n      cid,\n      week,\n      slot_no,\n      picked.key,\n      picked.title,\n      picked.category,\n      picked.rarity,\n      picked.xp,\n      '{}'::uuid[],\n      null\n    )\n    on conflict (couple_id, week_start, slot) do nothing;\n  end loop;\n\n  select count(*)::integer\n    into quest_count\n  from public.bond_weekly_quests\n  where couple_id = cid\n    and week_start = week;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'week_start', week,\n    'mode', quest_mode,\n    'quest_count', quest_count\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_assign_subjects(target_couple uuid, items jsonb, heavy text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_assign_subjects(target_couple uuid, items jsonb, heavy text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare n integer; heavy_left integer; other_left integer; other text := private.game_v2_partner_role(heavy);\n  subjects text[]; e jsonb; k integer := 0; pref text; alt integer := 0;\nbegin\n  select count(*) into n from jsonb_array_elements(items) x where x->>'mechanic' = 'prediction';\n  heavy_left := (n + 1) / 2; other_left := n / 2;\n  subjects := array_fill(null::text, array[greatest(jsonb_array_length(items), 1)]);\n  -- Pass 1: rotate the perspective of prompts the couple already played.\n  for e in select value from jsonb_array_elements(items) loop\n    k := k + 1;\n    continue when e->>'mechanic' <> 'prediction';\n    select private.game_v2_partner_role(i.subject_role) into pref\n      from public.game_session_items i join public.game_sessions s on s.id = i.session_id\n      where s.couple_id = target_couple and s.engine_version = 2 and i.fingerprint = e->>'candidate_key'\n        and i.subject_role is not null\n      order by s.started_at desc limit 1;\n    if pref = heavy and heavy_left > 0 then subjects[k] := heavy; heavy_left := heavy_left - 1;\n    elsif pref = other and other_left > 0 then subjects[k] := other; other_left := other_left - 1;\n    end if;\n  end loop;\n  -- Pass 2: the rest alternate, heavy first, within the remaining split.\n  k := 0;\n  for e in select value from jsonb_array_elements(items) loop\n    k := k + 1;\n    continue when e->>'mechanic' <> 'prediction' or subjects[k] is not null;\n    if (alt % 2 = 0 and heavy_left > 0) or other_left = 0 then subjects[k] := heavy; heavy_left := heavy_left - 1;\n    else subjects[k] := other; other_left := other_left - 1; end if;\n    alt := alt + 1;\n  end loop;\n  return (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when x.value->>'mechanic' = 'prediction'\n      then x.value || jsonb_build_object('subject_role', subjects[x.ordinality::integer]) else x.value end\n      order by x.ordinality), '[]'::jsonb)\n    from jsonb_array_elements(items) with ordinality x);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select ('catalog:' || c.id), c.family, c.mechanic, c.answer_kind, c.question_text, c.predict_text,\n    c.options, c.depth, c.topic, 'curated', c.id, c.id, c.version, null::uuid, null::integer,\n    '{}'::jsonb, c.cooldown_class, 50 + 3 * (c.depth - 1), null::integer, null::boolean, null::timestamptz\n  from public.game_v2_catalog c\n  where c.active and c.source_type = 'curated' and (target_family = 'per_voi' or c.family = target_family)\n  union all\n  -- Couple-authored questions (weekly and M11A library). Unplayed ones are\n  -- the most authentic content available and rank first.\n  select ('custom:' || q.id::text), fam.family,\n    case when fam.family = 'quanto_mi_conosci' then 'prediction' else 'reciprocal' end,\n    q.answer_kind, q.question_text,\n    case when fam.family = 'quanto_mi_conosci' then q.question_text end,\n    q.options, 2::smallint, ('custom_' || replace(q.id::text, '-', '_')), 'couple_custom', q.id::text,\n    null::text, null::integer, q.id, q.version,\n    jsonb_build_object('author_role', q.author_role, 'origin', q.origin),\n    'custom',\n    case when played.at is not null then 35 when q.origin = 'weekly' then 95 else 85 end,\n    null::integer, null::boolean, null::timestamptz\n  from public.couple_questions q\n  cross join lateral (select case when target_family = 'per_voi' then q.families[1] else target_family end as family) fam\n  left join lateral (select max(s.started_at) as at from public.game_session_items i\n    join public.game_sessions s on s.id = i.session_id where i.source_question_id = q.id) played on true\n  where q.couple_id = target_couple and q.archived_at is null\n    and (target_family = 'per_voi' or target_family = any (q.families))\n    and (fam.family <> 'quanto_mi_conosci' or q.answer_kind = 'choice')\n  union all\n  select * from private.game_v2_context_candidates(target_couple, target_family, at_time);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_clean_title(raw text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_clean_title(raw text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case when t is null or char_length(t) not between 3 and 60 or t !~ '[[:alpha:]]'\n      or t ~* '(https?://|www\\.|[a-z0-9-]+\\.(com|it|net|org)\\y)' then null else t end\n  from (select nullif(btrim(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(raw, ''), '«»“”\"', '     '), '\\s+', ' ', 'g')), '') t) x;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_clock()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_clock()\n RETURNS timestamp with time zone\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$ select now() $function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_context_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_context_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select * from private.game_v2_ctx_da_vivere(target_couple, target_family, at_time)\n  union all select * from private.game_v2_ctx_calendar(target_couple, target_family, at_time)\n  union all select * from private.game_v2_ctx_moments(target_couple, target_family, at_time)\n  union all select * from private.game_v2_ctx_conservati(target_couple, target_family, at_time)\n  union all select * from private.game_v2_ctx_longitudinal(target_couple, target_family, at_time);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_ctx_calendar(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_ctx_calendar(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare upcoming jsonb; past jsonb; at_date date := (at_time at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  week text := private.game_v2_week_start(at_time)::text;\nbegin\n  -- Shared entries only; an entry already represented by a Da vivere item is\n  -- left to that adapter so the same plan never appears twice.\n  with shared as (\n    select e.id, private.game_v2_clean_title(e.title) title,\n      coalesce((e.starts_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date, e.start_date) as on_day\n    from public.calendar_entries e\n    where e.couple_id = target_couple and e.entry_type = 'shared'\n      and not exists (select 1 from public.bucket_items b where b.calendar_entry_id = e.id)\n  )\n  select\n    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x.src) from (\n      select jsonb_build_object('id', s.id::text, 'title', s.title, 'date', private.game_v2_day_label(s.on_day)) src\n      from shared s where s.title is not null and s.on_day between at_date + 1 and at_date + 60\n      order by s.on_day, s.id limit 4) x), '[]'::jsonb),\n    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x.src) from (\n      select jsonb_build_object('id', s.id::text, 'title', s.title, 'when', private.game_v2_when_label(s.on_day, at_date)) src\n      from shared s where s.title is not null and s.on_day between at_date - 365 and at_date - 7\n      order by md5(target_couple::text || ':' || s.id::text || ':' || week) limit 4) x), '[]'::jsonb)\n  into upcoming, past;\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'calendar_upcoming', 'calendar', upcoming, at_time);\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'calendar_past', 'calendar', past, at_time);\nexception when others then\n  raise warning 'game_v2 context adapter calendar skipped: %', sqlerrm;\n  return;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_ctx_conservati(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_ctx_conservati(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare kept boolean;\nbegin\n  select exists (select 1 from public.conserva_contributions c\n    where c.couple_id = target_couple and c.created_at between at_time - interval '365 days' and at_time) into kept;\n  if not kept then return; end if;\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'conservati', 'conservati',\n    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id', 'conservati')), at_time);\nexception when others then\n  raise warning 'game_v2 context adapter conservati skipped: %', sqlerrm;\n  return;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_ctx_da_vivere(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_ctx_da_vivere(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare ideas jsonb; lived jsonb; at_date date := (at_time at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  week text := private.game_v2_week_start(at_time)::text;\nbegin\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.src), '[]'::jsonb) into ideas from (\n    select jsonb_build_object('id', b.id::text, 'title', t.title) src\n    from public.bucket_items b cross join lateral (select private.game_v2_clean_title(b.title) title) t\n    where b.couple_id = target_couple and b.status in ('idea', 'scheduled') and t.title is not null\n    order by md5(target_couple::text || ':' || b.id::text || ':' || week) limit 4) x;\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.src), '[]'::jsonb) into lived from (\n    select jsonb_build_object('id', b.id::text, 'title', t.title,\n      'when', private.game_v2_when_label((b.completed_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date, at_date)) src\n    from public.bucket_items b cross join lateral (select private.game_v2_clean_title(b.title) title) t\n    where b.couple_id = target_couple and b.status = 'lived' and t.title is not null\n      and b.completed_at is not null\n      and (b.completed_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date between at_date - 730 and at_date - 3\n    order by md5(target_couple::text || ':' || b.id::text || ':' || week) limit 4) x;\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'da_vivere_idea', 'da_vivere', ideas, at_time);\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'da_vivere_lived', 'da_vivere', lived, at_time);\nexception when others then\n  raise warning 'game_v2 context adapter da_vivere skipped: %', sqlerrm;\n  return;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_ctx_longitudinal(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_ctx_longitudinal(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare at_date date := (at_time at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\nbegin\n  return query\n  with plays as (\n    select i.id item_id, i.source_ref catalog_id, s.started_at, s.completed_at,\n      (select count(*) from public.game_session_answers a where a.item_id = i.id and a.answer_text is not null) answered\n    from public.game_session_items i join public.game_sessions s on s.id = i.session_id\n    where s.couple_id = target_couple and s.engine_version = 2 and i.source_type in ('curated', 'game_history')\n  ), last_play as (\n    select distinct on (p.catalog_id) p.catalog_id, p.started_at last_started from plays p\n    order by p.catalog_id, p.started_at desc\n  ), previous as (\n    select distinct on (p.catalog_id) p.catalog_id, p.item_id, p.started_at, p.completed_at from plays p\n    where p.completed_at is not null and p.answered = 2\n    order by p.catalog_id, p.completed_at desc\n  )\n  select ('longitudinal:' || c.id), c.family, 'reciprocal'::text, 'open'::text,\n    private.game_v2_fill(r.question_text, jsonb_build_object('previous_question', c.question_text)),\n    null::text, '[]'::jsonb, c.depth, c.topic, 'game_history'::text, c.id, r.id, r.version, null::uuid, null::integer,\n    jsonb_build_object('kind', 'longitudinal',\n      'kind_label', private.game_v2_fill(r.kind_label, jsonb_build_object('when',\n        private.game_v2_when_label((pv.started_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date, at_date))),\n      'source_type', 'game_history', 'source_id', c.id, 'previous_item_id', pv.item_id,\n      'previous_played_at', pv.started_at, 'recipe_id', r.id, 'recipe_version', r.version, 'captured_at', at_time),\n    r.cooldown_class, 72, null::integer, null::boolean, null::timestamptz\n  from public.game_v2_catalog c\n  join previous pv on pv.catalog_id = c.id\n  join last_play lp on lp.catalog_id = c.id\n  join public.game_v2_recipes r on r.adapter = 'longitudinal' and r.active\n  where c.active and c.longitudinal and c.mechanic = 'reciprocal' and c.answer_kind = 'open'\n    and (target_family = 'per_voi' or c.family = target_family)\n    and lp.last_started <= at_time - interval '90 days'\n  -- One resurfacing at a time: the prompt answered longest ago.\n  order by pv.started_at, c.id\n  limit 1;\nexception when others then\n  raise warning 'game_v2 context adapter longitudinal skipped: %', sqlerrm;\n  return;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_ctx_moments(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_ctx_moments(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare src jsonb; at_date date := (at_time at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  week text := private.game_v2_week_start(at_time)::text;\nbegin\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.src), '[]'::jsonb) into src from (\n    select jsonb_build_object('id', coalesce(p.source_ref, m.id)::text, 'title', t.title,\n      'when', private.game_v2_when_label(t.on_day, at_date), 'origin', coalesce(p.source_kind, 'moment')) src\n    from public.moments m\n    left join public.living_provenance p\n      on p.target_kind = 'moment' and p.target_ref = m.id and p.couple_id = m.couple_id\n    cross join lateral (select private.game_v2_clean_title(m.caption) title,\n      coalesce(m.moment_date, (m.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date) as on_day) t\n    where m.couple_id = target_couple and t.title is not null and t.on_day between at_date - 730 and at_date - 14\n    order by md5(target_couple::text || ':' || m.id::text || ':' || week) limit 4) x;\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'moment', 'moment',\n    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(src) s where s->>'origin' = 'moment'), at_time);\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'moment', 'da_vivere',\n    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(src) s where s->>'origin' = 'da_vivere'), at_time);\n  return query select * from private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family, 'moment', 'shared_event_completion',\n    (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(src) s where s->>'origin' = 'shared_event_completion'), at_time);\nexception when others then\n  raise warning 'game_v2 context adapter moments skipped: %', sqlerrm;\n  return;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_day_label(d date)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_day_label(d date)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select extract(day from d)::integer::text || ' ' || private.game_v2_month_name(d);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_families()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_families()\n RETURNS text[]\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select array['scopritevi', 'confrontatevi', 'ridete', 'quanto_mi_conosci', 'rivivete', 'e_se']::text[];\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_fill(template text, source jsonb)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_fill(template text, source jsonb)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select replace(replace(replace(replace(template,\n    '{title}', coalesce(source->>'title', '')), '{date}', coalesce(source->>'date', '')),\n    '{when}', coalesce(source->>'when', '')), '{previous_question}', coalesce(source->>'previous_question', ''));\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_items_immutable()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_items_immutable()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\nbegin\n  raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'game session items are immutable';\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_month_name(d date)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_month_name(d date)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select (array['gennaio', 'febbraio', 'marzo', 'aprile', 'maggio', 'giugno', 'luglio', 'agosto',\n    'settembre', 'ottobre', 'novembre', 'dicembre'])[extract(month from d)::integer];\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_partner_role(target_role text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_partner_role(target_role text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case target_role when 'francesco' then 'beatrice' when 'beatrice' then 'francesco' end;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_push_event(kind text, couple uuid, recipient text, sender text, reference text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_push_event(kind text, couple uuid, recipient text, sender text, reference text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select jsonb_build_object('kind', kind, 'couple_id', couple, 'recipient_role', recipient, 'sender_role', sender,\n    'reference', reference,\n    'dedupe_key', case kind\n      when 'game_waiting' then 'game-waiting:' || reference || ':' || recipient\n      when 'game_reveal' then 'game-reveal:' || reference || ':' || recipient\n      when 'game_weekly_created' then 'game-weekly-created:' || couple::text || ':' || reference\n      when 'game_weekly_turn' then 'game-weekly-turn:' || couple::text || ':' || reference end);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_question_sealed(target_question_id uuid, question_origin text, question_author text, caller_role text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_question_sealed(target_question_id uuid, question_origin text, question_author text, caller_role text)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select question_origin = 'weekly' and question_author <> caller_role\n    and not exists (select 1 from public.game_session_items i where i.source_question_id = target_question_id);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family text, target_adapter text, source_kind text, sources jsonb, at_time timestamp with time zone)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_recipe_candidates(target_family text, target_adapter text, source_kind text, sources jsonb, at_time timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select ('recipe:' || r.id || ':' || source_kind || ':' || (s->>'id')), r.family, r.mechanic, r.answer_kind,\n    private.game_v2_fill(r.question_text, s), null::text, r.options, r.depth, r.topic, source_kind, s->>'id',\n    r.id, r.version, null::uuid, null::integer,\n    jsonb_build_object('kind', r.adapter, 'kind_label', private.game_v2_fill(r.kind_label, s),\n      'source_type', source_kind, 'source_id', s->>'id', 'title', s->>'title', 'when', coalesce(s->>'when', s->>'date'),\n      'recipe_id', r.id, 'recipe_version', r.version, 'captured_at', at_time),\n    r.cooldown_class, 70 + 2 * (r.depth - 1), null::integer, null::boolean, null::timestamptz\n  from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(sources, '[]'::jsonb)) s\n  join public.game_v2_recipes r on r.adapter = target_adapter and r.active\n    and (target_family = 'per_voi' or r.family = target_family);\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_render(template text, subject text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_render(template text, subject text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select replace(replace(replace(template, '{subject}', coalesce(private.game_v2_role_label(subject), '{subject}')),\n    '{francesco}', 'Francesco'), '{beatrice}', 'Bea');\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_render_options(raw jsonb, subject text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_render_options(raw jsonb, subject text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(private.game_v2_render(o.value, subject)) order by o.ordinality), '[]'::jsonb)\n  from jsonb_array_elements_text(raw) with ordinality o;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_role_label(target_role text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_role_label(target_role text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select case target_role when 'francesco' then 'Francesco' when 'beatrice' then 'Bea' end;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_scored_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone, round_ordinal integer)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_scored_candidates(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone, round_ordinal integer)\n RETURNS SETOF private.game_v2_candidate\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  with hist as (\n    select i.fingerprint, i.recipe_id, i.source_type, i.source_ref, i.topic, s.started_at\n    from public.game_session_items i join public.game_sessions s on s.id = i.session_id\n    where s.couple_id = target_couple and s.engine_version = 2\n  )\n  select c.candidate_key, c.family, c.mechanic, c.answer_kind, c.question_text, c.predict_text, c.options,\n    c.depth, c.topic, c.source_type, c.source_ref, c.recipe_id, c.recipe_version, c.source_question_id,\n    c.source_version, c.context, c.cooldown_class, c.base_score,\n    c.base_score\n      + (('x' || substr(md5(target_couple::text || ':' || c.candidate_key || ':' || round_ordinal::text), 1, 2))::bit(8)::integer % 12)\n      - case when h.last_topic > at_time - make_interval(days => cd.topic_days) then 15 else 0 end,\n    coalesce(h.last_exact > at_time - make_interval(days => cd.item_days), false)\n      or coalesce(c.recipe_id is not null and h.last_recipe > at_time - make_interval(days => cd.recipe_days), false)\n      or coalesce(h.last_source > at_time - make_interval(days => cd.source_days), false),\n    greatest(h.last_exact, h.last_recipe, h.last_source)\n  from private.game_v2_candidates(target_couple, target_family, at_time) c\n  join public.game_v2_cooldowns cd on cd.cooldown_class = c.cooldown_class\n  cross join lateral (\n    select max(hist.started_at) filter (where hist.fingerprint = c.candidate_key) as last_exact,\n      max(hist.started_at) filter (where c.recipe_id is not null and hist.recipe_id = c.recipe_id) as last_recipe,\n      max(hist.started_at) filter (where hist.source_type = c.source_type and hist.source_ref = c.source_ref) as last_source,\n      max(hist.started_at) filter (where hist.topic = c.topic) as last_topic\n    from hist\n  ) h;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.game_v2_select_items(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone, round_ordinal integer)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.game_v2_select_items(target_couple uuid, target_family text, at_time timestamp with time zone, round_ordinal integer)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  picked jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; keys text[] := '{}'; fams text[] := '{}'; topics text[] := '{}';\n  sources text[] := '{}'; n_custom counts_rhythm, action_day, created_at\n  )\n  values (\n    target_couple, target_actor, target_source_kind, btrim(target_source_key),\n    greatest(0, coalesce(target_xp, 0)), coalesce(target_counts_rhythm, true),\n    action_day, coalesce(target_action_at, now())\n  )\n  on conflict (couple_id, source_kind, source_key) do nothing\n  returning id into inserted_id;\n\n  if inserted_id is not null and add_to_bond and coalesce(target_xp, 0) > 0 then\n    update public.couples\n       set bond_xp = coalesce(bond_xp, 0) + target_xp\n     where id = target_couple\n    returning bond_xp into current_xp;\n  else\n    select coalesce(c.bond_xp, 0) into current_xp from public.couples c where c.id = target_couple;\n  end if;\n\n  perform private.progression_sync_unlocks(target_couple, current_xp);\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'recorded', inserted_id is not null,\n    'xp_added', case when inserted_id is not null and add_to_bond then greatest(0, coalesce(target_xp, 0)) else 0 end,\n    'total_xp', coalesce(current_xp, 0),\n    'level', private.progression_level(coalesce(current_xp, 0)),\n    'action_day', action_day\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.progression_couples_xp_trigger()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.progression_couples_xp_trigger()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n end if;\n  return new;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.progression_daily_trigger()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.progression_daily_trigger()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  total integer := greatest(0, coalesce(total_xp, 0));\n  level_no integer := 1;\n  floor_xp integer := 0;\n  needed integer := 200;\nbegin\n  while total >= floor_xp + needed loop\n    floor_xp := floor_xp + needed;\n    level_no := level_no + 1;\n    needed := 200 + (level_no - 1) * 150;\n    exit when level_no > 999;\n  end loop;\n  return level_no;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.progression_level_info(total_xp integer)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.progression_level_info(total_xp integer)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  total integer := greatest(0, coalesce(total_xp, 0));\n  level_no integer := 1;\n  floor_xp integer := 0;\n  needed integer := 200;\n  current_xp integer;\nbegin\n  while total >= floor_xp + needed loop\n    floor_xp := floor_xp + needed;\n    level_no := level_no + 1;\n    needed := 200 + (level_no - 1) * 150;\n    exit when level_no > 999;\n  end loop;\n  current_xp := total - floor_xp;\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'total_xp', total,\n    'level', level_no,\n    'current_xp', current_xp,\n    'needed_xp', needed,\n    'remaining_xp', greatest(0, needed - current_xp),\n    'progress', case when needed > 0 then (current_xp::numeric / needed::numeric) else 0 end\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.progression_milestone_trigger()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.progression_milestone_trigger()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY FUNCTION private.progression_sync_unlocks(target_couple uuid, supplied_xp integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS public.couples c where c.id = target_couple;\n  else\n    total := greatest(0, supplied_xp);\n  end if;\n  if total is null then return; end if;\n  level_no := private.progression_level(total);\n  insert into public.couple_reward_unlocks(couple_id, reward_id)\n  select target_couple, reward.id\n    from public.progression_reward_catalog reward\n   where reward.active = true and reward.level_required <= level_no\n  on conflict (couple_id, reward_id) do nothing;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.progression_think_trigger()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION  2, new.created_at, true, true\n    );\n  end if;\n  return new;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.reroll_bond_quest_internal(target_quest_id uuid, target_template_key text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reroll_bond_quest_internal(target_quest_id uuid, target_template_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  q public.bond_weekly_quests%rowtype;\n  s public.bond_weekly_state%rowtype;\n  t public.bond_quest_templates%rowtype;\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  cid uuid;\n  quest_mode text;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then\n    raise exception 'Not authenticated';\n  end if;\n\n  cid := private.current_couple_id();\n  if cid is null then\n    raise exception 'Couple not found';\n  end if;\n\n  select *\n    into q\n  from public.bond_weekly_quests\n  where id = target_quest_id\n    and couple_id = cid\n  for update;\n\n  if not found then\n    raise exception 'Quest not found';\n  end if;\n\n  if q.week_start <> private.bond_week_start_rome(now()) then\n    raise exception 'Quest week is closed';\n  end if;\n\n  if q.completed_at is not null then\n    raise exception 'Quest already completed';\n  end if;\n\n  if cardinality(q.confirmed_by) > 0 then\n    raise exception 'Quest already confirmed';\n  end if;\n\n  select *\n    into s\n  from public.bond_weekly_state\n  where couple_id = q.couple_id\n    and week_start = q.week_start\n  for update;\n\n  if not found then\n    raise exception 'Weekly state not found';\n  end if;\n\n  if s.rerolls_used >= 3 then\n    raise exception 'No rerolls left';\n  end if;\n\n  select *\n    into t\n  from public.bond_quest_templates\n  where key = target_template_key\n    and active = true;\n\n  if not found then\n    raise exception 'Template not found';\n  end if;\n\n  quest_mode := private.bond_mode_for_couple(cid);\n\n  if not (t.mode = 'any' or t.mode = quest_mode) then\n    raise exception 'Template not eligible for current couple mode';\n  end if;\n\n  if exists (\n    select 1\n    from public.bond_weekly_quests x\n    where x.couple_id = q.couple_id\n      and x.week_start = q.week_start\n      and x.id <> q.id\n      and x.template_key = t.key\n  ) then\n    raise exception 'Template already used';\n  end if;\n\n  update public.bond_weekly_quests\n    set template_key = t.key,\n        title = t.title,\n        category = t.category,\n        rarity = t.rarity,\n        xp = t.xp,\n        confirmed_by = '{}'::uuid[],\n        completed_at = null\n  where id = q.id;\n\n  update public.bond_weekly_state\n    set rerolls_used = rerolls_used + 1\n  where couple_id = q.couple_id\n    and week_start = q.week_start\n  returning * into s;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'rerolls_used', s.rerolls_used,\n    'template_key', t.key\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"private.set_left_for_you_cleanup_eligible_at()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION required'; end if;\n  if not exists (\n    select 1 from public.couple_reward_unlocks u\n     where u.couple_id = cid and u.reward_id = target_reward_id\n  ) then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'reward not unlocked';\n  end if;\n  insert into public.progression_reward_views(couple_id, reward_id, profile_id)\n  values (cid, target_reward_id, uid)\n  on conflict (couple_id, reward_id, profile_id) do nothing;\n  return jsonb_build_object('acknowledged', true, 'reward_id', target_reward_id);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.archive_couple_question(target_question_id archived_at is null;\n  return jsonb_build_object('id', q.id, 'archived', true);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.award_relationship_milestone(target_couple_id uuid, target_milestone_date date, bond_xp=coalesce(bond_xp,0)+target_xp where id=target_couple_id;\n  insert into public.activity(couple_id,actor_id,type,payload)\n  values(target_couple_id,null,'relationship_milestone',jsonb_build_object('date',target_milestone_date,'months',target_months,'kind',target_kind,'xp',target_xp));\n  return true;\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.calendar_reminder_offset_valid(p_entry_id uuid, p_offset_minutes integer)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calendar_reminder_offset_valid(p_entry_id uuid, );\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.claim_left_for_you_cleanup(target_batch_size integer)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_left_for_you_cleanup(target_batch_size integer DEFAULT 100)\n RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, couple_id uuid, sender_id uuid, kind text, media_path text, source_deleted_at timestamp with time zone, claimed_at timestamp with time zone)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  requested_batch integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(target_batch_size, 100), 500));\nbegin\n  update private.left_for_you_cleanup_queue as stale\n  set claimed_at = null\n  where stale.completed_at is null\n    and stale.claimed_at < now() - interval '15 minutes';\n\n  insert into private.left_for_you_cleanup_queue\n    (item_id, couple_id, sender_id, kind, media_path)\n  select\n    item.id,\n    item.couple_id,\n    item.sender_id,\n    item.kind,\n    item.media_path\n  from public.left_for_you as item\n  where item.cleanup_eligible_at is not null\n    and item.seen_at is not null\n    and item.seen_at < now() - interval '30 days'\n    and not exists (\n      select 1\n      from public.conserva_contributions as contribution\n      where contribution.source_item_id = item.id\n    )\n    and not exists (\n      select 1\n      from private.left_for_you_cleanup_queue as queued\n      where queued.item_id = item.id\n        and queued.completed_at is null\n    )\n  on conflict on constraint left_for_you_cleanup_queue_pkey do nothing;\n\n  return query\n  with claimable as (\n    select queue.item_id\n    from private.left_for_you_cleanup_queue as queue\n    where queue.completed_at is null\n      and queue.claimed_at is null\n    order by queue.source_deleted_at nulls first, queue.item_id\n    limit requested_batch\n    for update skip locked\n  )\n  update private.left_for_you_cleanup_queue as queue\n  set claimed_at = now()\n  from claimable\n  where queue.item_id = claimable.item_id\n  returning queue.item_id, queue.couple_id, queue.sender_id, queue.kind,\n    queue.media_path, queue.source_deleted_at, queue.claimed_at;\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.claim_us_role(invite_code text, chosen_role text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_us_role(invite_code text, chosen_role text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions'\nAS $function$\r\ndeclare\r\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\r\n  inv public.couple_invites%rowtype;\r\n  old_uid uuid;\r\n  old_avatar text;\r\n  old_created_at timestamptz;\r\n  display text;\r\n  is_anon boolean;\r\nbegin\r\n  if uid is null then\r\n    raise exception 'Authentication required';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select coalesce((raw_app_meta_data->>'provider') = 'anonymous', false)\r\n      or coalesce((raw_user_meta_data->>'is_anonymous')::boolean, false)\r\n      or email is null\r\n  into is_anon\r\n  from auth.users where id = uid;\r\n\r\n  if not coalesce(is_anon, false) then\r\n    raise exception 'Anonymous session required for private pairing';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if chosen_role not in ('francesco','beatrice') then\r\n    raise exception 'Invalid role';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select * into inv\r\n  from public.couple_invites\r\n  where code_hash = encode(extensions.digest(upper(trim(invite_code))::text, 'sha256'::text), 'hex')\r\n    and role = chosen_role\r\n  for update;\r\n\r\n  if inv.id is null then\r\n    raise exception 'Invalid private code';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  if exists (\r\n    select 1 from public.profiles\r\n    where id = uid and (couple_id is distinct from inv.couple_id or role is distinct from chosen_role)\r\n  ) then\r\n    raise exception 'This device is already linked to another profile';\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  select id, avatar_path, created_at\r\n  into old_uid, old_avatar, old_created_at\r\n  from public.profiles\r\n  where couple_id = inv.couple_id and role = chosen_role\r\n  limit 1\r\n  for update;\r\n\r\n  display := case chosen_role when 'francesco' then 'Francesco' else 'Beatrice' end;\r\n\r\n  if old_uid is not null and old_uid <> uid then\r\n    -- Temporarily remove the old profile from the partial unique index\r\n    -- (couple_id, role) while keeping the profile row alive for FK safety.\r\n    update public.profiles\r\n    set couple_id = null\r\n    where id = old_uid;\r\n\r\n    -- Create the replacement profile BEFORE moving profile-owned foreign keys.\r\n    insert into public.profiles(id, display_name, couple_id, role, created_at, avatar_path)\r\n    values (uid, display, inv.couple_id, chosen_role, coalesce(old_created_at, now()), old_avatar)\r\n    on conflict (id) do update\r\n      set display_name = excluded.display_name,\r\n          couple_id = excluded.couple_id,\r\n          role = excluded.role,\r\n          avatar_path = coalesce(excluded.avatar_path, public.profiles.avatar_path);\r\n\r\n    -- Core historical data.\r\n    update public.daily_answers set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.quiz_responses set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    -- M7A: bucket_items now carries a created_by-immutability guard trigger\r\n    -- (20260929090000). The trigger blocks this reassignment by default;\r\n    -- this session-local flag authorises exactly this one statement, for\r\n    -- exactly this transfer, mirroring the calendar_entries carve-out below.\r\n    perform set_config('us.bucket_items_repair_transfer', 'on', true);\r\n    update public.bucket_items set created_by = uid where created_by = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    perform set_config('us.bucket_items_repair_transfer', 'off', true);\r\n    update public.shared_messages set sender_id = uid where sender_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.shared_messages set recipient_id = uid where recipient_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.moods set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.activity set actor_id = uid where actor_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n\r\n    -- Current US 1.0 profile-owned data.\r\n    update public.couple_locations set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.device_push_tokens set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.moments set created_by = uid where created_by = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.moment_photos set created_by = uid where created_by = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.notification_preferences set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid;\r\n    update public.partner_knowledge_attempts set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.push_event_log set sender_id = uid where sender_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.push_subscriptions set user_id = uid where user_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.shared_event_completions set completed_by = uid where completed_by = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.shared_events set created_by = uid where created_by = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.stories set author_id = uid where author_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n    update public.story_views set viewer_id = uid where viewer_id = old_uid;\r\n    update public.widget_tokens set profile_id = uid where profile_id = old_uid and couple_id = inv.couple_id;\r\n\r\n    -- M6A: calendar_entries (added by 20260928071749, not part of the\r\n    -- original production function). owner_id and created_by move together\r\n    -- in one statement so a personal row never has owner_id <> created_by\r\n    -- mid-transfer (calendar_entries_personal_owner_is_creator_check would\r\n    -- otherwise reject it); shared rows keep owner_id null and only\r\n    -- created_by moves. The guard trigger blocks created_by changes by\r\n    -- default, so this session-local flag authorises exactly this transfer,\r\n    -- for exactly this one statement.\r\n    perform set_config('us.calendar_entries_repair_transfer', 'on', true);\r\n    update public.calendar_entries\r\n    set created_by = uid,\r\n        owner_id = case when owner_id = old_uid then uid else owner_id end\r\n    where couple_id = inv.couple_id\r\n      and (created_by = old_uid or owner_id = old_uid);\r\n    perform set_config('us.calendar_entries_repair_transfer', 'off', true);\r\n\r\n    update public.couple_invites set used_by = uid, used_at = now() where id = inv.id;\r\n\r\n    -- All references now point to the new profile, so this delete is safe.\r\n    delete from public.profiles where id = old_uid;\r\n  else\r\n    insert into public.profiles(id, display_name, couple_id, role, avatar_path)\r\n    values (uid, display, inv.couple_id, chosen_role, old_avatar)\r\n    on conflict (id) do update\r\n      set display_name = excluded.display_name,\r\n          couple_id = excluded.couple_id,\r\n          role = excluded.role,\r\n          avatar_path = coalesce(excluded.avatar_path, public.profiles.avatar_path);\r\n  end if;\r\n\r\n  update public.couple_invites\r\n  set used_by = uid, used_at = now()\r\n  where id = inv.id;\r\n\r\n  return jsonb_build_object('couple_id', inv.couple_id, 'role', chosen_role, 'display_name', display);\r\nend;\r\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.complete_game_session_side(target_session_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_game_session_side(target_session_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; s public.game_sessions%rowtype; required_count integer; answered_count integer;\n  locked_at timestamptz;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  -- One lock order for save/finalize/seen. Concurrent partner completions\n  -- serialize here; the second one sets completed_at exactly once.\n  select * into s from public.game_sessions\n    where id = target_session_id and couple_id = actor.caller_couple for update;\n  if s.id is null then raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'session unavailable'; end if;\n  select completed_at into locked_at from public.game_session_sides\n    where session_id = s.id and actor_role = actor.caller_role;\n  if locked_at is not null then\n    return private.m11a_session_state(s.id, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role);\n  end if;\n  select count(*), count(a.item_id) into required_count, answered_count\n    from public.game_session_items i\n    left join public.game_session_answers a on a.item_id = i.id and a.actor_role = actor.caller_role\n    where i.session_id = s.id;\n  if required_count = 0 or answered_count <> required_count then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'answer required';\n  end if;\n  update public.game_session_sides set completed_at = now()\n    where session_id = s.id and actor_role = actor.caller_role;\n  if (select count(*) from public.game_session_sides side\n      where side.session_id = s.id and side.completed_at is not null) = 2 then\n    update public.game_sessions set completed_at = coalesce(completed_at, now()) where id = s.id;\n  end if;\n  return private.m11a_session_state(s.id, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.complete_left_for_you_cleanup(target_item_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_left_for_you_cleanup(target_item_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS jsonb_build_object('status', 'absent', 'item_id', target_item_id);\n  end if;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object('status', 'completed', 'item_id', target_item_id);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.complete_partner_knowledge_deck(target_deck smallint, target_guesses jsonb)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_partner_knowledge_deck(target_deck smallint, target_guesses jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid:=auth.uid(); cid uuid; pid uuid; partner_name text; ws date:=date_trunc('week',current_timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  required_count integer; valid_count integer; score_count integer; awarded integer; inserted_id uuid; stored public.partner_knowledge_attempts%rowtype; details jsonb;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;\n  if target_deck not between 1 and 3 then raise exception 'Invalid deck'; end if;\n  if jsonb_typeof(target_guesses)<>'object' then raise exception 'Invalid guesses'; end if;\n  select couple_id into cid from public.profiles where id=uid;\n  if cid is null then raise exception 'Profile not linked'; end if;\n  select id,display_name into pid,partner_name from public.profiles where couple_id=cid and id<>uid limit 1;\n  if pid is null then raise exception 'Partner not linked'; end if;\n  select * into stored from public.partner_knowledge_attempts where couple_id=cid and user_id=uid and week_start=ws and deck=target_deck;\n  if not found then\n    with latest as (\n      select distinct on(qr.question_id) qr.question_id,qr.answer_index from public.quiz_responses qr join public.quiz_sets qs on qs.id=qr.set_id where qr.user_id=pid and qr.couple_id=cid and qs.mode='match' order by qr.question_id,qr.updated_at desc\n    ), ranked as (\n      select q.id question_id,q.options,l.answer_index,row_number() over(order by md5(q.id::text||ws::text||uid::text)) rn from latest l join public.quiz_questions q on q.id=l.question_id\n    ), selected as (\n      select *,((rn-1)/5+1)::int deck from ranked where rn<=15\n    )\n    select count(*),count(*) filter(where target_guesses ? question_id::text and (target_guesses->>question_id::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' and (target_guesses->>question_id::text)::int>=0 and (target_guesses->>question_id::text)::int<jsonb_array_length(options)),count(*) filter(where target_guesses ? question_id::text and (target_guesses->>question_id::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$' and (target_guesses->>question_id::text)::int=answer_index)\n    into required_count,valid_count,score_count from selected where deck=target_deck;\n    if required_count=0 then raise exception 'Knowledge deck unavailable'; end if;\n    if valid_count<>required_count then raise exception 'Complete every answer first'; end if;\n    awarded:=least(50,score_count*10);\n    insert into public.partner_knowledge_attempts(couple_id,user_id,week_start,deck,guesses,score,xp_awarded) values(cid,uid,ws,target_deck,target_guesses,score_count,awarded) on conflict(couple_id,user_id,week_start,deck) do nothing returning id into inserted_id;\n    if inserted_id is not null then\n      update public.couples set bond_xp=coalesce(bond_xp,0)+awarded where id=cid;\n      insert into public.activity(couple_id,actor_id,type,payload) values(cid,uid,'partner_knowledge_completed',jsonb_build_object('deck',target_deck,'partner_name',partner_name,'score',score_count,'xp',awarded));\n    end if;\n    select * into stored from public.partner_knowledge_attempts where couple_id=cid and user_id=uid and week_start=ws and deck=target_deck;\n  end if;\n  with latest as (\n    select distinct on(qr.question_id) qr.question_id,qr.answer_index from public.quiz_responses qr join public.quiz_sets qs on qs.id=qr.set_id where qr.user_id=pid and qr.couple_id=cid and qs.mode='match' order by qr.question_id,qr.updated_at desc\n  ), ranked as (\n    select q.id question_id,q.question,q.options,l.answer_index,row_number() over(order by md5(q.id::text||ws::text||uid::text)) rn from latest l join public.quiz_questions q on q.id=l.question_id\n  ), selected as (\n    select *,((rn-1)/5+1)::int deck from ranked where rn<=15\n  )\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',question_id,'question',question,'options',options,'your_answer',(stored.guesses->>question_id::text)::int,'partner_answer',answer_index,'correct',((stored.guesses->>question_id::text)::int=answer_index)) order by rn),'[]'::jsonb) into details from selected where deck=target_deck;\n  return jsonb_build_object('completed',true,'partner_name',partner_name,'deck',target_deck,'score',stored.score,'xp_awarded',stored.xp_awarded,'reward_granted_now',inserted_id is not null,'questions',details);\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.complete_shared_event(target_event_id uuid, target_occurrence_date date)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_shared_event(target_event_id uuid, target_occurrence_date date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'auth'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid := auth.uid(); cid uuid; e public.shared_events%rowtype; existing public.shared_event_completions%rowtype;\n  awarded integer; lead_days integer; today_rome date := (current_timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;\n  select couple_id into cid from public.profiles where id=uid;\n  if cid is null then raise exception 'Profile not linked'; end if;\n  select * into e from public.shared_events where id=target_event_id and couple_id=cid for update;\n  if not found then raise exception 'Event not found'; end if;\n  if target_occurrence_date is null or target_occurrence_date > today_rome then raise exception 'Event cannot be completed yet'; end if;\n  if e.recurs_yearly then\n    if extract(month from target_occurrence_date) <> extract(month from e.event_date) or extract(day from target_occurrence_date) <> extract(day from e.event_date) then raise exception 'Invalid recurring occurrence'; end if;\n  elsif target_occurrence_date <> e.event_date then raise exception 'Invalid occurrence date'; end if;\n  select * into existing from public.shared_event_completions where event_id=e.id and occurrence_date=target_occurrence_date;\n  if found then return jsonb_build_object('completed',true,'already_completed',true,'xp_awarded',existing.xp_awarded,'completed_at',existing.completed_at); end if;\n  lead_days := greatest(0, target_occurrence_date - (e.created_at at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date);\n  awarded := case when e.recurs_yearly then 60 when lead_days >= 7 then 50 when lead_days >= 2 then 35 else 25 end;\n  insert into public.shared_event_completions(event_id,couple_id,occurrence_date,completed_by,xp_awarded) values(e.id,cid,target_occurrence_date,uid,awarded);\n  update public.couples set bond_xp=coalesce(bond_xp,0)+awarded where id=cid;\n  insert into public.activity(couple_id,actor_id,type,payload) values(cid,uid,'shared_event_completed',jsonb_build_object('event_id',e.id,'title',e.title,'occurrence_date',target_occurrence_date,'xp',awarded));\n  return jsonb_build_object('completed',true,'already_completed',false,'xp_awarded',awarded,'occurrence_date',target_occurrence_date);\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.confirm_bond_quest(target_quest_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_bond_quest(target_quest_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\n  select private.confirm_bond_quest_internal(target_quest_id)\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.confirm_bucket_item_lived(p_item_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_bucket_item_lived(p_item_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  v_item public.bucket_items%rowtype;\n  v_seen_proposer uuid;\n  v_seen_couple uuid;\n  v_ids uuid[];\n  v_lock record;\n  v_caller_couple uuid;\n  v_proposer_couple uuid;\n  v_proposer_is_member boolean := false;\nbegin\n  if v_uid is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'bucket_items_lived_requires_authenticated_member';\n  end if;\n\n  -- Strategia di lock (stesso ordine del flusso claim_us_role, che blocca il\n  -- profilo PRIMA delle righe bucket_items: profili -> riga, mai il contrario,\n  -- quindi nessun deadlock con il re-pair):\n  --   1. lettura SENZA lock della riga, solo per sapere coppia e proponente;\n  --   2. lock FOR SHARE dei profili coinvolti (chi chiama + proponente), in\n  --      ordine deterministico per id: un re-pair/rimozione (che li blocca\n  --      FOR UPDATE o li cancella) aspetta la fine di questa transazione, e\n  --      chi è già stato rimosso non si vede più (la lettura sotto lock è\n  --      quella corrente, non quella di prima dell'attesa);\n  --   3. lock FOR UPDATE della riga e RIVERIFICA dopo l'attesa: coppia e\n  --      proponente devono essere ancora quelli su cui abbiamo bloccato i\n  --      profili, altrimenti 40001 (retry sicuro: la RPC è idempotente).\n  select b.couple_id, b.lived_proposed_by into v_seen_couple, v_seen_proposer\n  from public.bucket_items b where b.id = p_item_id;\n  -- Stesso errore per \"non esiste\" e \"è di un'altra coppia\": la RPC non\n  -- rivela l'esistenza di righe fuori dalla coppia di chi chiama.\n  if not found then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'bucket_items_not_found';\n  end if;\n\n  v_ids := array[v_uid];\n  if v_seen_proposer is not null and v_seen_proposer <> v_uid then\n    v_ids := v_ids || v_seen_proposer;\n  end if;\n\n  for v_lock in\n    select p.id, p.couple_id from public.profiles p\n    where p.id = any(v_ids)\n    order by p.id\n    for share\n  loop\n    if v_lock.id = v_uid then v_caller_couple := v_lock.couple_id; end if;\n    if v_lock.id = v_seen_proposer then v_proposer_couple := v_lock.couple_id; end if;\n  end loop;\n\n  if v_caller_couple is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'bucket_items_lived_requires_authenticated_member';\n  end if;\n  if v_caller_couple <> v_seen_couple then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'bucket_items_not_found';\n  end if;\n\n  select b.* into v_item from public.bucket_items b where b.id = p_item_id for update;\n  if not found or v_item.couple_id <> v_caller_couple then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'bucket_items_not_found';\n  end if;\n  if v_item.lived_proposed_by is distinct from v_seen_proposer then\n    raise exception using errcode = '40001', message = 'bucket_items_lived_proposal_changed_retry';\n  end if;\n\n  if v_item.status not in ('idea', 'scheduled', 'lived') then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = format('bucket_items_lived_not_allowed_from: %s', v_item.status);\n  end if;\n\n  if v_item.status <> 'lived' then\n    -- Il proponente vale solo se è ANCORA membro della stessa coppia (letto\n    -- sotto lock: non può cambiare fino al commit).\n    v_proposer_is_member := v_item.lived_proposed_by is not null\n      and v_item.lived_proposed_by <> v_uid\n      and v_proposer_couple is not distinct from v_item.couple_id;\n\n    perform set_config('us.bucket_items_lived_confirm', 'on', true);\n    if v_item.lived_proposed_by is null\n       or (v_item.lived_proposed_by <> v_uid and not v_proposer_is_member) then\n      update public.bucket_items\n        set lived_proposed_by = v_uid, lived_proposed_at = now()\n        where id = p_item_id;\n    elsif v_item.lived_proposed_by <> v_uid then\n      update public.bucket_items set status = 'lived' where id = p_item_id;\n    end if;\n    perform set_config('us.bucket_items_lived_confirm', 'off', true);\n  end if;\n\n  select b.* into v_item from public.bucket_items b where b.id = p_item_id;\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'id', v_item.id,\n    'status', v_item.status,\n    'calendar_entry_id', v_item.calendar_entry_id,\n    'completed', v_item.completed,\n    'completed_at', v_item.completed_at,\n    'lived_proposed_by', v_item.lived_proposed_by,\n    'lived_proposed_at', v_item.lived_proposed_at\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.conserve_left_for_you(target_item_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conserve_left_for_you(target_item_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  target_item public.left_for_you%rowtype;\n  existing_row public.conserva_contributions%rowtype;\n  created_row public.conserva_contributions%rowtype;\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'authentication required';\n  end if;\n\n  select entry.* into target_item\n  from public.left_for_you as entry\n  where entry.id = target_item_id\n    and entry.couple_id = private.current_couple_id()\n    and entry.recipient_id = auth.uid()\n  for update;\n\n  if target_item.id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'conserva_recipient_required';\n  end if;\n\n  insert into public.conserva_contributions as c\n    (couple_id, source_item_id, source_sender_id, conserved_by)\n  values\n    (target_item.couple_id, target_item.id, target_item.sender_id, auth.uid())\n  on conflict (source_item_id) do nothing\n  returning c.* into created_row;\n\n  if created_row.id is not null then\n    return jsonb_build_object(\n      'id', created_row.id,\n      'status', 'created',\n      'couple_id', created_row.couple_id,\n      'source_item_id', created_row.source_item_id,\n      'source_sender_id', created_row.source_sender_id,\n      'conserved_by', created_row.conserved_by,\n      'created_at', created_row.created_at\n    );\n  end if;\n\n  select e.* into existing_row\n  from public.conserva_contributions as e\n  where e.source_item_id = target_item.id;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'id', existing_row.id,\n    'status', 'existing',\n    'couple_id', existing_row.couple_id,\n    'source_item_id', existing_row.source_item_id,\n    'source_sender_id', existing_row.source_sender_id,\n    'conserved_by', existing_row.conserved_by,\n    'created_at', existing_row.created_at\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.create_couple_question(request_id uuid, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_couple_question(request_id uuid, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; normalized jsonb; q public.couple_questions%rowtype;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if request_id is null then raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request id required'; end if;\n  normalized := private.m11a_valid_options(answer_kind, question_text, options);\n  insert into public.couple_questions(couple_id, author_role, create_request_id, question_text, answer_kind, options)\n  values (actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role, request_id, btrim(question_text), answer_kind, normalized)\n  on conflict (couple_id, author_role, create_request_id) do nothing returning * into q;\n  if q.id is null then\n    select * into q from public.couple_questions\n    where couple_id = actor.caller_couple and author_role = actor.caller_role and create_request_id = request_id;\n    if q.question_text <> btrim(question_text) or q.answer_kind <> answer_kind or q.options <> normalized then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n  end if;\n  return private.m11a_question_json(q);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.create_weekly_question(request_id uuid, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb, families text[])","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_weekly_question(request_id uuid, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb, families text[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; normalized jsonb; cleaned_families text[]; week date; existing public.couple_questions%rowtype;\n  at_time timestamptz := private.game_v2_clock();\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if request_id is null then raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request id required'; end if;\n  normalized := private.m11a_valid_options(answer_kind, question_text, options);\n  cleaned_families := private.game_v2_valid_families(families, answer_kind);\n  -- Serialize every weekly write of the couple (double taps, both partners,\n  -- a retry racing its original); the partial unique index stays the final\n  -- authority.\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('game_v2_weekly:' || actor.caller_couple::text, 0));\n\n  select * into existing from public.couple_questions q\n    where q.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and q.author_role = actor.caller_role\n      and q.create_request_id = create_weekly_question.request_id;\n  if existing.id is not null then\n    if existing.origin <> 'weekly' or existing.question_text <> btrim(create_weekly_question.question_text)\n      or existing.answer_kind <> create_weekly_question.answer_kind or existing.options <> normalized\n      or existing.families <> cleaned_families then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n    return private.game_v2_weekly_state(actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role, at_time)\n      || jsonb_build_object('question_id', existing.id, 'replayed', true);\n  end if;\n\n  week := private.game_v2_week_start(at_time);\n  if private.game_v2_weekly_role(week) <> actor.caller_role then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'not your turn';\n  end if;\n  if exists (select 1 from public.couple_questions q\n      where q.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and q.origin = 'weekly' and q.week_start = week) then\n    raise exception using errcode = '23505', message = 'weekly question already created';\n  end if;\n  insert into public.couple_questions(couple_id, DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare uid uuid:=auth.uid(); cid uuid; pid uuid; partner_name text; ws date:=date_trunc('week',current_timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date; decks jsonb;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;\n  select couple_id into cid from public.profiles where id=uid;\n  if cid is null qs.id=qr.set_id\n    where qr.user_id=pid and qr.couple_id=cid and qs.mode='match'\n    order by qr.question_id,qr.updated_at desc\n  ), ranked as (\n    select q.id question_id,q.question,q.options,row_number() over(order by md5(q.id::text||ws::text||uid::text)) rn\n    from latest l join public.quiz_questions q on q.id=l.question_id\n  ), selected as (\n    select *,((rn-1)/5+1)::int deck from ranked where rn<=15\n  ), deck_rows as (\n    select s.deck,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.question_id,'question',s.question,'options',s.options) order by s.rn) questions,count(*) cnt\n    from selected s group by s.deck\n  )\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('deck',d.deck,'questions',d.questions,'count',d.cnt,'completed',a.id is not $function$\n"},{"f":"public.get_progression_v1()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_progression_v1()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  cid uuid;\n  total integer;\n  level_data jsonb;\n  today_rome date := (now() at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  last_day date;\n  rhythm integer := 0;\n  rewards jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;\n  pending jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;\n  next_reward jsonb;\n  prefs public.couple_progression_preferences%rowtype;\n  slots jsonb;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'authentication required';\n  end if;\n  select p.couple_id into cid from public.profiles p where p.id = uid;\n  if cid is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'couple membership required';\n  end if;\n\n  select coalesce(c.bond_xp, 0) into total from public.couples c where c.id = cid;\n  if total is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'couple not found';\n  end if;\n  perform private.progression_sync_unlocks(cid, total);\n  level_data := private.progression_level_info(total);\n\n  select pref.* into prefs from public.couple_progression_preferences pref where pref.couple_id = cid;\n  slots := jsonb_build_object(\n    'frame', prefs.frame_reward_id,\n    'theme', prefs.theme_reward_id,\n    'accent', prefs.accent_reward_id,\n    'effect', prefs.effect_reward_id,\n    'badge', prefs.badge_reward_id,\n    'sticker', prefs.sticker_reward_id,\n    'ring', prefs.ring_reward_id\n  );\n\n  select max(e.action_day) into last_day\n    from public.progression_events e\n   where e.couple_id = cid and e.counts_rhythm = true and e.action_day <= today_rome;\n\n  if last_day is not null and last_day >= today_rome - 1 then\n    with days as (\n      select distinct e.action_day\n        from public.progression_events e\n       where e.couple_id = cid and e.counts_rhythm = true and e.action_day <= last_day\n    ), ranked as (\n      select d.action_day, row_number() over(order by d.action_day desc) as rn from days d\n    )\n    select count(*)::integer into rhythm\n      from ranked r\n     where r.action_day = last_day - ((r.rn - 1)::integer);\n  end if;\n\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n      'id', reward.id,\n      'level_required', reward.level_required,\n      'category', reward.category,\n      'title', reward.title,\n      'description', reward.description,\n      'token', reward.token,\n      'unlocked', unlock.reward_id is not null,\n      'equipped', unlock.reward_id is not null and (slots ->> reward.category) = reward.id\n    ) order by reward.sort_order), '[]'::jsonb)\n    into rewards\n    from public.progression_reward_catalog reward\n    left join public.couple_reward_unlocks unlock\n      on unlock.couple_id = cid and unlock.reward_id = reward.id\n   where reward.active = true;\n\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n      'id', reward.id,\n      'level_required', reward.level_required,\n      'category', reward.category,\n      'title', reward.title,\n      'description', reward.description,\n      'token', reward.token\n    ) order by reward.sort_order), '[]'::jsonb)\n    into pending\n    from public.progression_reward_catalog reward\n    join public.couple_reward_unlocks unlock\n      on unlock.couple_id = cid and unlock.reward_id = reward.id\n    left join public.progression_reward_views seen\n      on seen.couple_id = cid and seen.reward_id = reward.id and seen.profile_id = uid\n   where reward.active = true and reward.announce = true and seen.reward_id is null;\n\n  select jsonb_build_object(\n      'id', reward.id,\n      'level_required', reward.level_required,\n      'category', reward.category,\n      'title', reward.title,\n      'description', reward.description,\n      'token', reward.token\n    )\n    into next_reward\n    from public.progression_reward_catalog reward\n   where reward.active = true\n     and reward.level_required > private.progression_level(total)\n   order by reward.level_required, reward.sort_order\n   limit 1;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'total_xp', total,\n    'level', (level_data->>'level')::integer,\n    'current_xp', (level_data->>'current_xp')::integer,\n    'needed_xp', (level_data->>'needed_xp')::integer,\n    'remaining_xp', (level_data->>'remaining_xp')::integer,\n    'progress', (level_data->>'progress')::numeric,\n    'rhythm_days', coalesce(rhythm, 0),\n    'rhythm_today', exists(\n      select 1 from public.progression_events e\n       where e.couple_id = cid and e.counts_rhythm = true and e.action_day = today_rome\n    ),\n    'today', today_rome,\n    'rewards', rewards,\n    'pending_unlocks', pending,\n    'next_reward', next_reward,\n    'preferences', jsonb_build_object(\n      'frame_reward_id', prefs.frame_reward_id,\n      'theme_reward_id', prefs.theme_reward_id,\n      'accent_reward_id', prefs.accent_reward_id,\n      'effect_reward_id', prefs.effect_reward_id,\n      'badge_reward_id', prefs.badge_reward_id,\n      'sticker_reward_id', prefs.sticker_reward_id,\n      'ring_reward_id', prefs.ring_reward_id\n    )\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.get_quiz_state(target_set_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_quiz_state(target_set_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid := auth.uid(); cid uuid; ws date := date_trunc('week', current_timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date;\n  total_count integer:=0; my_count integer:=0; partner_count integer:=0; score integer:=null;\n  my_answers jsonb:='{}'::jsonb; partner_answers jsonb:=null; reward_xp integer:=null; inserted_xp integer:=null; reward_granted_now boolean:=false; set_mode text:='match';\nbegin\n  if uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;\n  select couple_id into cid from public.profiles where id=uid;\n  if cid is null then raise exception 'Profile not linked'; end if;\n  select coalesce(mode,'match') into set_mode from public.quiz_sets where id=target_set_id;\n  if set_mode is null then raise exception 'Quiz set not found'; end if;\n  select count(*) into total_count from public.quiz_questions where set_id=target_set_id;\n  if total_count=0 then raise exception 'Quiz set not found or empty'; end if;\n  select count(*),coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(question_id::text,answer_index),'{}'::jsonb) into my_count,my_answers from public.quiz_responses where set_id=target_set_id and couple_id=cid and user_id=uid and week_start=ws;\n  select count(*) into partner_count from public.quiz_responses where set_id=target_set_id and couple_id=cid and user_id<>uid and week_start=ws;\n  if my_count>=total_count and partner_count>=total_count then\n    select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(question_id::text,answer_index),'{}'::jsonb) into partner_answers from public.quiz_responses where set_id=target_set_id and couple_id=cid and user_id<>uid and week_start=ws;\n    select count(*) into score from public.quiz_responses mine join public.quiz_responses partner on partner.question_id=mine.question_id and partner.set_id=mine.set_id and partner.couple_id=mine.couple_id and partner.week_start=mine.week_start and partner.user_id<>mine.user_id where mine.set_id=target_set_id and mine.couple_id=cid and mine.user_id=uid and mine.week_start=ws and mine.answer_index=partner.answer_index;\n    reward_xp := case when set_mode='match' then score*5 else 20+score*3 end;\n    insert into public.weekly_quiz_rewards(couple_id,set_id,week_start,score,xp_awarded) values(cid,target_set_id,ws,score,reward_xp) on conflict(couple_id,set_id,week_start) do nothing returning xp_awarded into inserted_xp;\n    if inserted_xp is not null then update public.couples set bond_xp=coalesce(bond_xp,0)+inserted_xp where id=cid; reward_granted_now:=true; end if;\n    select xp_awarded into reward_xp from public.weekly_quiz_rewards where couple_id=cid and set_id=target_set_id and week_start=ws;\n  end if;\n  return jsonb_build_object('mode',set_mode,'total',total_count,'my_count',my_count,'partner_count',partner_count,'my_complete',my_count>=total_count,'partner_complete',partner_count>=total_count,'both_complete',my_count>=total_count and partner_count>=total_count,'my_answers',my_answers,'partner_answers',partner_answers,'score',score,'week_start',ws,'xp_awarded',reward_xp,'reward_granted_now',reward_granted_now);\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.get_web_push_status()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_web_push_status()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO count(*) into subscription_count from public.push_subscriptions where user_id = uid;\n  return jsonb_build_object('active',subscription_count > 0,'count',subscription_count);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.get_weekly_game_sets()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_weekly_game_sets()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY
