loop\n    with ranked as (\n      select id,slug,title,category,mode,row_number() over(order by md5(slug))-1 rn,count(*) over() cnt from public.quiz_sets where mode=mode_name\n    ), positioned as (\n      select id,slug,title,category,mode,cnt,mod((rn-mod(week_index*3,cnt)+cnt),cnt) pos from ranked\n    )\n    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'slug',slug,'title',title,'category',category,'mode',mode) order by pos),'[]'::jsonb) into arr from positioned where pos<least(3,cnt);\n    result := result || jsonb_build_object(mode_name,arr);\n  end loop;\n  return result || jsonb_build_object('week_start',ws,'next_refresh',ws+7);\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.get_weekly_question_state()","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_weekly_question_state()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare uid uuid := auth.uid(); cid uuid; ws date := date_trunc('week', current_timestamp at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date; week_index integer := id=uid;\n  if cid is null then raise exception 'Profile not linked'; end if;\n  with ranked as (\n    select id,slug,title,category,row_number() over(order by md5(slug))-1 rn,count(*) over() cnt from public.quiz_sets where mode='match'\n  ), positioned as (\n    select id,slug,title,category,cnt,mod((rn-mod(week_index*3,cnt)+cnt),cnt) pos from ranked\n  ), chosen as (\n    select jsonb_build_object('week_start',ws,'next_refresh',ws+7,'sets',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'slug',slug,'title',title,'category',category,'mode','match') order by pos),'[]'::jsonb)) into result from chosen;\n  return result;\nend; $function$\n"},{"f":"public.keep_daily_question(target_question_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.keep_daily_question(target_question_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  actor record;\n  question public.daily_questions%rowtype;\n  kept public.daily_question_keepsakes%rowtype;\n  daily_state jsonb;\n  mine text;\n  theirs text;\n  opened_at timestamptz;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if target_question_id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22004', message = 'daily_question_id_required';\n  end if;\n\n  -- Retry / reconnect / double tap: the kept row answers as it is.\n  select k.* into kept from public.daily_question_keepsakes k\n    where k.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and k.question_id = target_question_id;\n  if found then\n    return private.daily_question_keepsake_json(kept, 'existing');\n  end if;\n\n  select q.* into question from public.daily_questions q where q.id = target_question_id;\n  if not found then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'daily_question_not_found';\n  end if;\n\n  -- The reveal authority decides. Nothing is read before both_answered.\n  daily_state := public.get_daily_state(target_question_id);\n  if not coalesce((daily_state->>'both_answered')::boolean, false) then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'daily_question_reveal_not_ready';\n  end if;\n  mine := daily_state->>'my_answer';\n  theirs := daily_state->>'partner_answer';\n  if mine is null or theirs is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '55000', message = 'daily_question_answers_unavailable';\n  end if;\n\n  select max(a.created_at) into opened_at from public.daily_answers a\n    where a.question_id = target_question_id and a.couple_id = actor.caller_couple;\n\n  -- Both partners may keep at the same moment: serialize per couple + Daily.\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'us:daily_keepsake:' || actor.caller_couple::text || ':' || target_question_id::text, 0));\n\n  insert into public.daily_question_keepsakes (couple_id, question_id, question_text, question_date,\n    francesco_answer, beatrice_answer, revealed_at, kept_by_role)\n  values (actor.caller_couple, target_question_id, left(question.question, 500), question.question_date,\n    case when actor.caller_role = 'francesco' then mine else theirs end,\n    case when actor.caller_role = 'beatrice' then mine else theirs end,\n    coalesce(opened_at, now()), actor.caller_role)\n  on conflict (couple_id, question_id) do nothing\n  returning * into kept;\n\n  if kept.id is null then\n    -- The other partner (or an earlier tap) won; it is committed by now.\n    select k.* into kept from public.daily_question_keepsakes k\n      where k.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and k.question_id = target_question_id;\n    return private.daily_question_keepsake_json(kept, 'existing');\n  end if;\n\n  return private.daily_question_keepsake_json(kept, 'kept');\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.link_moment_to_source(target_moment_id uuid, source_kind text, source_ref uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.link_moment_to_source(target_moment_id uuid, source_kind text, source_ref uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  actor record;\n  target public.moments%rowtype;\n  completion record;\n  item record;\n  snap_title text;\n  snap_date date;\n  link_row public.living_provenance%rowtype;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if target_moment_id is null or source_ref is null or source_kind is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22004', message = 'living_provenance_arguments_required';\n  end if;\n  if source_kind not in ('shared_event_completion', 'da_vivere') then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'living_provenance_unsupported_source_kind';\n  end if;\n\n  -- Same error for \"does not exist\" and \"belongs to another couple\".\n  select m.* into target from public.moments m\n    where m.id = link_moment_to_source.target_moment_id and m.couple_id = actor.caller_couple;\n  if not found then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0002', message = 'living_provenance_moment_not_found';\n  end if;\n  if target.created_by is distinct from auth.uid() then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'living_provenance_moment_not_own';\n  end if;\n\n  if source_kind = 'shared_event_completion' then\n    select c.id, c.occurrence_date, coalesce(c.event_title_snapshot, e.title) as title into completion\n      from public.shared_event_completions c\n      left join 'public'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  uid uuid := auth.uid();\n  prefs public.notification_preferences%rowtype;\nbegin\n  if uid is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;\n  if target_key not in ('think', 'today', 'bond', 'relationship', 'left_for_you', 'games') then\n    raise exception 'Invalid preference';\n  end if;\n  insert into public.notification_preferences(user_id) values(uid)\n  on conflict(user_id) do nothing;\n  if target_key = 'think' then\n    update public.notification_preferences set think = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  elsif target_key = 'today' then\n    update public.notification_preferences set today = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  elsif target_key = 'bond' then\n    update public.notification_preferences set bond = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  elsif target_key = 'relationship' then\n    update public.notification_preferences set relationship = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  elsif target_key = 'left_for_you' then\n    update public.notification_preferences set left_for_you = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  else\n    update public.notification_preferences set games = target_value, updated_at = now() where user_id = uid;\n  end if;\n  select * into prefs from public.notification_preferences where user_id = uid;\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'think', prefs.think,\n    'today', prefs.today,\n    'bond', prefs.bond,\n    'relationship', prefs.relationship,\n    'left_for_you', prefs.left_for_you,\n    'games', prefs.games\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.set_think_reaction(target_message_id uuid, target_reaction text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_think_reaction(target_message_id uuid, target_reaction text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  current_couple uuid;\n  message public.shared_messages%rowtype;\n  existing public.think_reactions%rowtype;\n  result public.think_reactions%rowtype;\nbegin\n  if auth.uid() is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'authentication required';\n  end if;\n\n  if target_reaction not in ('heart', 'hug', 'miss_you') then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid think reaction';\n  end if;\n\n  current_couple := private.current_couple_id();\n\n  select msg.* into message\n  from public.shared_messages as msg\n  where msg.id = target_message_id\n    and msg.kind = 'think'\n    and msg.couple_id = current_couple\n    and msg.recipient_id = auth.uid()\n  for update;\n\n  if message.id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'think recipient required';\n  end if;\n\n  select reaction.* into existing\n  from public.think_reactions as reaction\n  where reaction.message_id = target_message_id\n  for update;\n\n  if existing.id is not null then\n    if existing.reaction = target_reaction then\n      return jsonb_build_object(\n        'status', 'duplicate',\n        'id', existing.id,\n        'message_id', existing.message_id,\n        'reaction', existing.reaction,\n        'updated_at', existing.updated_at\n      );\n    end if;\n\n    raise exception using errcode = '23505', message = 'already_reacted';\n  end if;\n\n  insert into public.think_reactions (message_id, reaction)\n  values (target_message_id, target_reaction)\n  returning * into result;\n\n  return jsonb_build_object(\n    'status', 'saved',\n    'id', result.id,\n    'message_id', result.message_id,\n    'reaction', result.reaction,\n    'updated_at', result.updated_at\n  );\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.start_custom_game_session(target_question_id uuid, request_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_custom_game_session(target_question_id uuid, request_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; q public.couple_questions%rowtype; sid uuid; original_question uuid;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if request_id is null then raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request id required'; end if;\n  -- Check the receipt first: a retry must still work after the source is edited\n  -- or archived. Unique (couple, role, request) resolves concurrent first calls.\n  select s.id, i.source_question_id into sid, original_question\n    from public.game_sessions s join public.game_session_items i on i.session_id = s.id and i.position = 1\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.started_by_role = actor.caller_role\n      and s.create_request_id = request_id;\n  if sid is not null then\n    if original_question is distinct from target_question_id then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role);\n  end if;\n  select * into q from public.couple_questions\n    where id = target_question_id and couple_id = actor.caller_couple and archived_at is null for share;\n  if q.id is null then raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'question unavailable'; end if;\n  insert into public.game_sessions(couple_id, game_family, content_source, started_by_role, create_request_id)\n    values(actor.caller_couple, 'couple_custom', 'couple_custom', actor.caller_role, request_id)\n    on conflict (couple_id, started_by_role, create_request_id) do nothing returning id into sid;\n  if sid is null then\n    select s.id, i.source_question_id into sid, original_question\n      from public.game_sessions s join public.game_session_items i on i.session_id = s.id and i.position = 1\n      where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.started_by_role = actor.caller_role\n        and s.create_request_id = request_id;\n    if sid is null or original_question is distinct from target_question_id then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n  else\n    insert into public.game_session_items(session_id, position, source_question_id, source_version,\n      question_text, answer_kind, options)\n      values(sid, 1, q.id, q.version, q.question_text, q.answer_kind, q.options);\n    insert into public.game_session_sides(session_id, actor_role)\n      values(sid, 'francesco'), (sid, 'beatrice');\n  end if;\n  return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.start_game_round(target_family text, request_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_game_round(target_family text, request_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; sid uuid; existing_family text; at_time timestamptz := private.game_v2_clock();\n  ordinal integer; heavy text; items jsonb; e jsonb; pos integer := 0; subject text;\n  sources text[]; source_kind text; usage jsonb;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  if request_id is null then raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request id required'; end if;\n  if target_family is null or not (target_family = 'per_voi' or target_family = any (private.game_v2_families())) then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid family';\n  end if;\n\n  -- Replay of an earlier request: always the original round, whatever the\n  -- allowance or the week is now.\n  select s.id, s.game_family into sid, existing_family from public.game_sessions s\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.started_by_role = actor.caller_role\n      and s.create_request_id = start_game_round.request_id;\n  if sid is not null then\n    if existing_family is distinct from target_family then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role) || jsonb_build_object('resumed', true);\n  end if;\n\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('game_v2_round:' || actor.caller_couple::text || ':' || target_family, 0));\n  select s.id into sid from public.game_sessions s\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.started_by_role = actor.caller_role\n      and s.create_request_id = start_game_round.request_id and s.game_family = target_family;\n  if sid is not null then\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role) || jsonb_build_object('resumed', true);\n  end if;\n  -- An open round of the same mode (from this week or an earlier one) is\n  -- resumed and spends nothing.\n  select s.id into sid from public.game_sessions s\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.engine_version = 2 and s.game_family = target_family\n      and s.completed_at is null;\n  if sid is not null then\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role) || jsonb_build_object('resumed', true);\n  end if;\n\n  -- Weekly budget. Taken after the per-mode lock on every path, so the lock\n  -- order is fixed; usage is read again under it (READ COMMITTED: a new\n  -- snapshot per statement sees a concurrent start that just committed).\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('game_v2_budget:' || actor.caller_couple::text, 0));\n  usage := private.game_v2_week_usage(actor.caller_couple, at_time);\n  if target_family = 'per_voi' and not (usage->>'per_voi_available')::boolean then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'weekly per voi played',\n      detail = 'resets_on=' || (usage->>'resets_on');\n  end if;\n  if target_family <> 'per_voi' and not (usage->>'free_available')::boolean then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'weekly allowance exhausted',\n      detail = 'resets_on=' || (usage->>'resets_on');\n  end if;\n  if (usage->>'open_count')::integer >= (usage->>'open_limit')::integer then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'too many open rounds';\n  end if;\n\n  select count(*) into ordinal from public.game_sessions s\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.engine_version = 2;\n  select case when count(*) % 2 = 0 then 'beatrice' else 'francesco' end into heavy\n    from public.game_sessions s\n    where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.engine_version = 2 and s.subject_heavy_role is not null;\n\n  items := private.game_v2_select_items(actor.caller_couple, target_family, at_time, ordinal);\n  if jsonb_array_length(items) < 5 then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'not enough content';\n  end if;\n  items := private.game_v2_assign_subjects(actor.caller_couple, items, heavy);\n  select array_agg(distinct x->>'source_type' order by x->>'source_type') into sources from jsonb_array_elements(items) x;\n  source_kind := case when sources = array['curated'] then 'curated'\n    when sources = array['couple_custom'] then 'couple_custom' else 'mixed' end;\n\n  -- started_at follows the server clock: it is what the weekly usage counts.\n  insert into public.game_sessions(couple_id, game_family, content_source, started_by_role, create_request_id,\n    engine_version, subject_heavy_role, started_at)\n  values (actor.caller_couple, target_family, source_kind, actor.caller_role, start_game_round.request_id, 2,\n    case when exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(items) x where x->>'mechanic' = 'prediction') then heavy end,\n    at_time)\n  returning id into sid;\n\n  for e in select value from jsonb_array_elements(items) loop\n    pos := pos + 1;\n    subject := e->>'subject_role';\n    insert into public.game_session_items(session_id, position, source_question_id, source_version,\n      question_text, answer_kind, options, mechanic, subject_role, predict_text, family, source_type,\n      source_ref, recipe_id, recipe_version, topic, perspective, depth, fingerprint, context)\n    values (sid, pos, (e->>'source_question_id')::uuid, (e->>'source_version')::integer,\n      private.game_v2_render(e->>'question_text', subject), e->>'answer_kind',\n      private.game_v2_render_options(e->'options', subject), e->>'mechanic', subject,\n      case when subject is not null then private.game_v2_render(e->>'predict_text', subject) end,\n      e->>'family', e->>'source_type', e->>'source_ref', e->>'recipe_id', (e->>'recipe_version')::integer,\n      e->>'topic', coalesce('subject:' || subject, 'mutual'), (e->>'depth')::smallint, e->>'candidate_key',\n      coalesce(e->'context', '{}'::jsonb));\n  end loop;\n  insert into public.game_session_sides(session_id, actor_role) values (sid, 'francesco'), (sid, 'beatrice');\n  return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role) || jsonb_build_object('resumed', false);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.start_swipe_round(request_id uuid)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_swipe_round(request_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  actor record;\n  sid uuid;\n  existing_family text;\n  at_time timestamptz := private.game_v2_clock();\n  usage jsonb;\n  ordinal integer;\n  cards jsonb;\n  card jsonb;\n  pos integer := 0;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n\n  if request_id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request id required';\n  end if;\n\n  -- Idempotent replay wins even if the weekly allowance is now spent.\n  select s.id, s.game_family into sid, existing_family\n  from public.game_sessions s\n  where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple\n    and s.started_by_role = actor.caller_role\n    and s.create_request_id = start_swipe_round.request_id;\n\n  if sid is not null then\n    if existing_family is distinct from 'swipe' then\n      raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'request already used';\n    end if;\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role)\n      || jsonb_build_object('resumed', true);\n  end if;\n\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended('game_v2_round:' || actor.caller_couple::text || ':swipe', 0)\n  );\n\n  -- One canonical open Swipe round for the couple.\n  select s.id into sid\n  from public.game_sessions s\n  where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple\n    and s.engine_version = 2\n    and s.game_family = 'swipe'\n    and s.completed_at is null;\n\n  if sid is not null then\n    return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role)\n      || jsonb_build_object('resumed', true);\n  end if;\n\n  -- Swipe spends one of the same two weekly free-choice moments as the\n  -- existing six modes. Resuming an older open Swipe spends nothing.\n  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended('game_v2_budget:' || actor.caller_couple::text, 0)\n  );\n  usage := private.game_v2_week_usage(actor.caller_couple, at_time);\n\n  if not (usage->>'free_available')::boolean then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'weekly allowance exhausted',\n      detail = 'resets_on=' || (usage->>'resets_on');\n  end if;\n\n  if (usage->>'open_count')::integer >= (usage->>'open_limit')::integer then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'too many open rounds';\n  end if;\n\n  select count(*)::integer into ordinal\n  from public.game_sessions s\n  where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple and s.engine_version = 2;\n\n  -- Prefer cards this couple has never seen, then the least-recently played.\n  -- md5 gives a deterministic shuffle inside each recency bucket.\n  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(picked) - 'last_played' - 'sort_key' order by picked.pick_order), '[]'::jsonb)\n  into cards\n  from (\n    select ranked.*, row_number() over (\n      order by ranked.last_played asc nulls first, ranked.sort_key\n    ) as pick_order\n    from (\n      select c.id, c.version, c.question_text, c.options, c.topic,\n        (\n          select max(s.started_at)\n          from public.game_session_items i\n          join public.game_sessions s on s.id = i.session_id\n          where s.couple_id = actor.caller_couple\n            and i.fingerprint = ('swipe:' || c.id || ':v' || c.version::text)\n        ) as last_played,\n        md5(\n          c.id || ':' || actor.caller_couple::text || ':' ||\n          private.game_v2_week_start(at_time)::text || ':' || ordinal::text\n        ) as sort_key\n      from private.game_swipe_v1_catalog c\n      where c.active\n    ) ranked\n    order by ranked.last_played asc nulls first, ranked.sort_key\n    limit 8\n  ) picked;\n\n  if jsonb_array_length(cards) <> 8 then\n    raise exception using errcode = 'P0001', message = 'not enough swipe content';\n  end if;\n\n  insert into public.game_sessions (\n    couple_id, game_family, content_source, started_by_role, create_request_id,\n    engine_version, started_at\n  )\n  values (\n    actor.caller_couple, 'swipe', 'curated', actor.caller_role,\n    start_swipe_round.request_id, 2, at_time\n  )\n  returning id into sid;\n\n  for card in select value from jsonb_array_elements(cards) loop\n    pos := pos + 1;\n    insert into public.game_session_items (\n      session_id, position, source_question_id, source_version,\n      question_text, answer_kind, options, mechanic, subject_role, predict_text,\n      family, source_type, source_ref, recipe_id, recipe_version, topic,\n      perspective, depth, fingerprint, context\n    )\n    values (\n      sid, pos, null, (card->>'version')::integer,\n      card->>'question_text', 'choice', card->'options', 'reciprocal', null, null,\n      null, 'curated', 'swipe:' || (card->>'id'), null, null, card->>'topic',\n      'mutual', 1, 'swipe:' || (card->>'id') || ':v' || (card->>'version'),\n      jsonb_build_object('swipe_v1', true)\n    );\n  end loop;\n\n  insert into public.game_session_sides(session_id, actor_role)\n  values (sid, 'francesco'), (sid, 'beatrice');\n\n  return private.m11a_session_state(sid, actor.caller_couple, actor.caller_role)\n    || jsonb_build_object('resumed', false);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.update_couple_question(target_question_id uuid, expected_version integer, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_couple_question(target_question_id uuid, expected_version integer, question_text text, answer_kind text, options jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare actor record; normalized jsonb; q public.couple_questions%rowtype;\nbegin\n  select * into actor from private.m11a_actor_locked();\n  normalized := private.m11a_valid_options(answer_kind, question_text, options);\n  select * into q from public.couple_questions\n    where id = target_question_id and couple_id = actor.caller_couple for update;\n  if q.id is null then raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'question unavailable'; end if;\n  if q.author_role <> actor.caller_role then raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'author only'; end if;\n  if q.archived_at is not null then raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'question archived'; end if;\n  if expected_version is distinct from q.version then raise exception using errcode = '40001', message = 'version conflict'; end if;\n  update public.couple_questions set question_text = btrim(update_couple_question.question_text),\n    answer_kind = update_couple_question.answer_kind, options = normalized,\n    version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = q.id returning * into q;\n  return private.m11a_question_json(q);\nend;\n$function$\n"},{"f":"public.widget_scriptable_exchange_internal(p_setup_token_hash text, p_device_id_hash text, p_state_token_hash text, p_action_token_hash text)","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.widget_scriptable_exchange_internal(p_setup_token_hash text, p_device_id_hash text, p_state_token_hash text, p_action_token_hash text)\n RETURNS TABLE(installation_id uuid, expires_at timestamp with time zone)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO ''\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n  setup_code public.widget_scriptable_setup_codes%rowtype;\n  setup_profile_id uuid;\n  current_profile_couple_id uuid;\n  action_token_id uuid;\n  new_installation_id uuid;\n  action_expiry timestamptz := now() + interval '180 days';\nbegin\n  if p_setup_token_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'\n     or p_device_id_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'\n     or p_state_token_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'\n     or p_action_token_hash !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' then\n    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'invalid_setup_request';\n  end if;\n\n  select code.profile_id into setup_profile_id\n  from public.widget_scriptable_setup_codes as code\n  where code.token_hash = p_setup_token_hash;\n  if setup_profile_id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '28000', message = 'invalid_or_expired_setup_code';\n  end if;\n  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(1, pg_catalog.hashtext(p_device_id_hash));\n  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(0, pg_catalog.hashtext(setup_profile_id::text));\n\n  select code.* into setup_code\n  from public.widget_scriptable_setup_codes as code\n  where code.token_hash = p_setup_token_hash\n    and code.consumed_at is null\n    and code.revoked_at is null\n    and code.expires_at > now()\n  for update;\n\n  if setup_code.id is null then\n    raise exception using errcode = '28000', message = 'invalid_or_expired_setup_code';\n  end if;\n\n  select profile.couple_id\n  into current_profile_couple_id\n  from public.profiles as profile\n  where profile.id = setup_code.profile_id\n  for update;\n\n  if not found or current_profile_couple_id is distinct from setup_code.couple_id then\n    raise exception using errcode = '28000', message = 'widget_profile_not_linked';\n  end if;\n\n  update public.widget_scriptable_installations as old_installation\n  set revoked_at = now()\n  where old_installation.profile_id = setup_code.profile_id\n    and old_installation.couple_id = setup_code.couple_id\n    and old_installation.device_id_hash = p_device_id_hash\n    and old_installation.revoked_at is null;\n\n  update public.widget_tokens as state_token\n  set revoked_at = now()\n  where state_token.token_hash in (\n    select old_installation.state_token_hash\n    from public.widget_scriptable_installations as old_installation\n    where old_installation.profile_id = setup_code.profile_id\n      and old_installation.couple_id = setup_code.couple_id\n      and old_installation.device_id_hash = p_device_id_hash\n      and old_installation.revoked_at is not null\n  )\n    and state_token.revoked_at is null;\n\n  update public.widget_action_tokens as action_token\n  set revoked_at = now()\n  where action_token.id in (\n    select old_installation.action_token_id\n    from public.widget_scriptable_installations as old_installation\n    where old_installation.profile_id = setup_code.profile_id\n      and old_installation.couple_id = setup_code.couple_id\n      and old_installation.device_id_hash = p_device_id_hash\n      and old_installation.revoked_at is not null\n  )\n    and action_token.revoked_at is null;\n\n  insert into public.widget_action_tokens(\n    couple_id, profile_id, device_id_hash, token_hash, scope, expires_at\n  ) values (\n    setup_code.couple_id, setup_code.profile_id,
